acceptance_criteria.description: Rows with nonzero or unobserved tool errors remain visible and are explicitly completion-ineligible.
Every native metric, BMP metric, usage value, failure, and evidence link remains in JSON and HTML.
The public five-benchmark matrix retains prior families and includes the missing common controls and memory families without live progress claims.
Focused tests, compileall, collaboration validation, lab doctor, and git diff check pass.

objective: Preserve every verified memory result while marking tool-error completion eligibility explicitly and publishing the stable cross-benchmark baseline capability inventory.
title: Gate memory completion and expand baseline matrix
